fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 4% of Gross Sales, due 7 days after end of each fiscal period (currently calendar month). Advertising and Promotion Obligation ("APO") not to exceed 5% of Gross Sales; currently 4% of Gross Sales directed to System Marketing Fund. Digital Marketing Fee currently none, but may be imposed up to 2% of Gross Sales in the future. I.T. Service and Support Fee is $1,260 billed quarterly ($420/month equivalent), covering help desk, back office, POS, menu management, and O365 licensing. Non-compliance fee of 1% of Gross Sales may be assessed for each month of default. Late fee of $500 per delinquent payment. Interest on delinquent payments at 18% per annum or maximum permitted by law. Transfer Fee of $5,000 plus out-of-pocket expenses. Renewal Fee of 50% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Purchasing Agent Fee of 8% of total purchase amount when Sugarloaf Management acts as purchasing agent. All fees generally non-refundable and payable to franchisor and/or Sugarloaf Management. Franchisor reserves right to adjust fixed-dollar fees for CPI inflation.
